packages/app-builder/src/myapps/configur.authorityBoundary: Binds trusted MyEve contract/runtime dependencies by content hashes into deterministic reference configuration. Describes execution identity; grants no admission, paid execution, installation or publication authority.

packages/app-builder/src/myapps/controll.authorityBoundary: Requires injected Work authorization and exact FactoryVersion binding; maintains owner-scoped candidate custody, idempotent requests and durable UNKNOWN fencing. Runs bounded producer/verifier subprocesses, requires producer cessation and verifier cleanup, and grants no model, network, installation or deployment authority.

packages/app-builder/src/myapps/producer.authorityBoundary: Validates bounded inert JSON against trusted contracts and emits canonical declarative package bytes. Runs under controller-imposed permissions; does not execute generated code or confer verification, installation or publication authority.

packages/app-builder/src/myapps/result.m.authorityBoundary: Signs and verifies exact candidate/configuration-bound reference Results and owner-scoped evidence. Promotion requires authenticated completed Result, matching package/candidate and confirmed verifier cleanup; conveys no installation, publication or production qualification grant.

packages/app-builder/src/myapps/verifier.authorityBoundary: Independently checks package digest, declarative runtime behavior, owner isolation and denied effects using trusted MyEve modules in a disposable reference store. Emits bounded check outcomes; its synthetic installation is confined to that store and grants no owner-registry or production authority.
